New just test nice 19 conflicts with unchanged shared-build.test.ts:306 literal niceness=19; shared-build adds nice 19 again. Shared-build expanded waiters cost three external utilities every 20s per waiter (0.15/s plus shell subprocess work), no idle cost, no FIFO fairness. Source touching forces own-crate rebuild per acquired recipe; smoke freshness costs build time. Author disk claims 2.4GB nested fixture build/69s versus zero target after tests; 15GB full targets contain rather than add to 2.4GB. Live baseline 20s 163.8 launches/s machine-wide; daemon 1531 unchanged over 21.752s, CPU ps15.9 RSS146592KiB, shared debug14G. Unmerged patch: these are baseline, not causal before/after.
